title: Mangrove Loss Fell From 187,000 To 102,000 Hectares
hook: Annual mangrove loss fell from 187,000 to 102,000 hectares.
closing: Slower loss proves protection can work, but slowing is not the same as stopping.
question: Can mangroves recover?

segments.say: Mangrove forest area fell to 15.2 million hectares, leaving coastlines with less natural protection.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves, more than any region shown.
Annual mangrove loss fell to 102,000 hectares, showing the pace of destruction can slow.
